name: Tsapa Payment Gateway for MTN Mobile Money in Africa
author: tsapa

sections.description:
Accept MTN Mobile Money payments instantly. This plugin adds a clean and secure checkout gate allowing your African customer bases to enter their MTN mobile number and authorize pay-outs via instant push USSD PIN code prompt screens.

Perfect for e-commerce shops operating in Rwanda, Uganda, Ghana, Zambia, Cameroon, Ivory Coast, Benin, Liberia, Republic of Congo, Guinea, and Eswatini.

External Services

This plugin connects to the MTN Mobile Money (MoMo) API to process payment requests and verify payment status.

Service Provider:
MTN Mobile Money (MoMo)

What the service is used for:
The service is used to request payments from customers and verify transaction status through the MTN Mobile Money platform.

What data is sent:

  • Customer phone number
  • Payment amount
  • Currency
  • Transaction reference
  • Transaction description

When data is sent:
Data is sent only when a customer initiates a payment through the payment gateway.

MTN MoMo Terms of Service:
https://momodeveloper.mtn.com/

MTN MoMo Privacy Policy:
https://momodeveloper.mtn.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire tsapa-payment-gateway-for-mtn-mobile-money-in-africa folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and configure the “MTN Mobile Money for Africa” gateway settings.
sections.faq:
Does this support sandbox testing?

Yes! Enable “Sandbox Mode” in your WooCommerce settings to test payment workflows with dummy mobile phone numbers.
